# Foryourgoal Studio

> High-throughput commercial image post-production studio specializing in 100% hand-drawn clipping paths, high-end product retouching, ghost mannequin composite, and jewelry editing for global e-commerce brands, catalog retailers, and commercial photographers.

## Core Capabilities
- **Clipping Path & Cutouts**: 100% Adobe Photoshop pen-tool vector paths with smooth bezier curves. Zero automated AI wand artifacts.
- **Product Photo Retouching**: Dust, scratch, surface blemish removal, symmetry correction, color balancing, and texture preservation.
- **Ghost Mannequin / Invisible Neck Joint**: Realistic 3D garment volume from multiple flat-lay or mannequin shots.
- **High-End Jewelry Retouching**: Macro scratch removal, metal luster restoration, hot-spot suppression, and gemstone facet brilliance.
- **Background Removal**: Pure white (#FFFFFF) Amazon/Google compliance, transparent PNGs, neutral grays, and contextual backdrops.
- **Shadow Creation & Reflection**: Natural soft drop shadows, directional cast shadows, and mirror reflections.
- **Color Correction & Multi-Colorway**: Pantone swatch matching and recoloring from a single master capture.
- **Image Masking**: Multi-channel alpha masking for flyaway hair, animal fur, lace, and semi-transparent glass.

## Operational Standards
- **Turnaround SLA**: Flexible 6-hour, 12-hour, and 24-hour turnaround windows.
- **Quality Assurance**: 3-tier inspection protocol (Artist self-check, QA Supervisor review, Technical Director sign-off).
- **Security & NDA**: Enterprise-grade confidentiality, encrypted file transit, 14-day automated file purge.
- **High-Volume Capacity**: Scalable infrastructure supporting 5,000+ images per day.
